text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dangerous "terrorist" Rihane Yahia and three of his associates killed in raid on their hideout in the Anassers district in southern Algiers.
- Socialist Forces Front is to take part in the June 5 legislative elections in Algeria.
- Algiers local authorities sign a cooperation accord with Barcelona mayor Pasqual Maragall.
- The energy and transport ministries hold a seminar to spearhead the use of the liquefied gas by transport users.
- Socialist Forces Front leader Hocine Ait Ahmed held a meeting with his deputies in the Moroccan city of Marrakesh where they agreed to participate in the Algerian legislative poll.
- Algiers to carry out an emergency plan to fight water shortage because of the drought this year.
